newsitem.title: CHINA: DuPont, BASF eye China nylon plant.
newsitem.headline: DuPont, BASF eye China nylon plant.

text.p: DuPont Co of the United States and Germany's BASF AG have selected China's southern province of Hainan as a possible site for a planned nylon plant, a DuPont China spokeswoman said on Monday.
"We've signed a memorandum of understanding with Hainan. But the site could still be changed," the spokeswoman said. She declined to give further details.
Hainan Governor Ruan Chongwu met visiting executives of DuPont and BASF after the two companies signed a preliminary accord with the Hainan government last Friday, the China News Service said.

DuPont and BASF in April announced plans to build a $700-800 million plant in Asia, probably in China, to produce nylon. The plant, a 50-50 joint venture, would produce 450,000 metric tonnes of nylon a year. Production would begin in 2001.
